Name: Bog's Animated Moon Gate Obelisks
Author: KoalaNet13
Description:
[center][color=#93c47d][b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=6]Bog's Obelisks are now animated!
[/size][/font][/b][/color][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#93c47d][b][size=6]2.0 - Expansion Mod Obelisks have been added[/size]
[/b][/color][/font][size=3](Ridsgeside Village, Visit Mount Vapius, East Scarp, Downtown Zuzu, and Deep Woods!)[/size][/center][center][size=3]Requires:[/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34624]Bog's Witchy Farm Buildings
[/url]OR
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24448]Bog's Moon Gate Obelisks
[/url][/size][/center][center]
AND

[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]﻿[/size][size=3]
[/size][/center]

[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/mrcCHWQd/All-Portals.gif[/img][/center][center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/gJ4cD3r2/Modded-Portals.gif[/img][img]https://i.postimg.cc/Sj0XZqfv/Woods-Portal.gif[/img]﻿
﻿[/center][center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/SxxWmMjb/Farm-Island.gif[/img]﻿[/center]﻿﻿

[center][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#93c47d][size=5]You can also now walk through them like true Moon Gates[/size][/color][/font][/center]

[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/pLcKrLnh/WalkIn.gif[/img][/center]
﻿
[center][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#93c47d][size=5][b]Config Options[/b][/size][/color][/font][/center]
[center][list]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]Ability to enter custom warp coordinates for vanilla obelisks as this mod will override vanilla warping[/size][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]Allows you to toggle walking through or the original click warp; You can physically walk through the portal while configured to Click[/size][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]Allows you to toggle individual obelisks for use with other retextures - You will have to play with load order/dependencies for other retextures to show over Bog's mod as well[/size][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]To fix compatibility with other warping mods you can turn off all collision edits - this will remove ability to walk through portal [/size][/font]
[/list][i]Note: You will have to reload the save in order for the Farm Obelisk to update[/i][/center][i]

[/i][center][i]Deep Woods Obelisk is now available!
Currently will only apply animated texture - enabling walking through is WIP[/i][/center]

[center][font=Trebuchet MS][size=5]Please check out the rest of [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch?gameId=1303&pk_vid=6d17b378111f860817545863725686e6]BogWyytch's Mods[/url]﻿
[/size][/font][/center]

[font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#b6d7a8][size=5][center]﻿Installation Guide[/center][/size][/color][/b][/font][center]Install SMAPI: Ensure you have the latest version of SMAPI installed.
Install Content Patcher: Required for the mod to work
Install SpaceCore: Required for the animations to work
Install Bog's Witchy Farm Buildings [i]or[/i] Bog's Moon Gate Obelisks
Download this mod: Get the latest version from the Files tab
Extract and place [i][CP] Bog's Animated Obelisks[/i] to your mods folder[/center]
